concepts.title: 가을 공원 넓은 돌계단, 내려오기
concepts.background: 낙엽이 드문드문한 조용한 공원의 넓고 낮은 연회색 돌계단 한 곳, 계단 맨 위에서 아래 참까지 같은 자리
concepts.background_en: A wide, shallow light-grey stone staircase in a quiet autumn park, a few scattered dry leaves on the steps, plain low stone walls on both sides, muted green-grey trees far behind, soft overcast sky, no people, no signs, no text. The stairs run from the top of the frame down toward the camera to a flat landing.
concepts.framing: 세로 9:16, 눈높이, 계단 아래 참에서 조금 떨어져 촬영, 멈출 때 전신이 화면 높이의 약 65%, 카메라 고정
concepts.light: 흐린 늦가을 오전, 부드럽고 그림자 없는 빛, 차분한 회색과 연한 올리브 색감
concepts.motion: 걷기 (계단을 내려와 아래 참에서 멈춰 포즈, 왼쪽으로 퇴장)
concepts.why: 연회색 계단이 핑크·블랙·아이보리·브라운을 모두 또렷하게 받쳐 주고, 계단을 내려오면 전신과 다리 라인(니삭스, 부츠)이 자연스럽게 길게 보임
concepts.pace: 보폭 중간, 1초에 약 2걸음, 난간 없이 팔은 가볍게
concepts.camera_en: Fixed camera at eye level (about 1.5 m high), about 7 m from the bottom landing, looking slightly up the staircase, vertical 9:16, no zoom, no shake, no movement.
concepts.pace_en: Relaxed confident descent, medium steps, about two steps per second, arms swinging gently, shoulders level, head up, no bouncing, no hurrying.
concepts.light_en: Soft overcast late-autumn morning light, no hard shadows, calm grey and pale olive tones.
concepts.direction_en: She descends the staircase from the top center toward the camera, stops on the flat landing at the center of the frame, then walks out of frame to the left.

shots.action: 계단 위에서 내려와 아래 참 가운데서 멈춘 뒤 왼쪽으로 퇴장
shots.pose: 멈춰서 오른손으로 숄더백 끈을 고쳐 잡고 카메라 보며 웃기
shots.motion_en: 0-3s: she walks down the stairs toward the camera with medium steps, about two steps per second, arms swinging loosely, growing from about 30% to about 50% of the frame height. 3-3.7s: she stops on the landing at the center at about 60% of the frame height, feet together, facing the camera. 3.7-4.7s: with her right hand she slides up the shoulder bag strap and settles it on her shoulder, then looks at the camera with a small smile. 4.7-5.5s: she walks out of frame to the left with a natural stride. One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts. There is no wind: hair and clothes move only with her steps and hands.
shots.start: 계단 맨 위 가운데, 전신이 화면 세로의 약 30%, 내려오는 중
shots.start_en: Tiny full-body figure at the top of the staircase, horizontally centered, about 30% of the frame height, mid-step with the left foot forward and arms swinging naturally at her sides, looking toward the camera; not posing yet, no clothing adjustments.

concepts.title: 황토빛 벽 골목, 모퉁이 돌아 나오기
concepts.background: 연한 황토색 회벽 건물이 꺾이는 모퉁이가 있는 조용한 돌바닥 골목 한 곳, 왼쪽 모퉁이 뒤에서 나와 가운데로 오는 자리
concepts.background_en: A quiet narrow lane with plain warm ochre-tan plastered walls and a clean building corner on the left side of the frame, light grey cobblestone ground, a narrow strip of pale blue sky above, no people, no signs, no text, no lamps. The lane continues to the right behind the camera side.
concepts.framing: 세로 9:16, 눈높이, 골목 맞은편에서 조금 떨어져 촬영, 멈출 때 전신이 화면 높이의 약 65%, 카메라 고정
concepts.light: 오전 10시쯤 비스듬히 드는 맑은 햇살, 벽에 따뜻한 빛, 하늘은 연한 파랑
concepts.motion: 걷기 (왼쪽 모퉁이를 돌아 나와 가운데서 멈춰 포즈, 오른쪽으로 퇴장)
concepts.why: 황토 벽이 핑크 트위드와 블랙, 그레이, 아이보리를 한꺼번에 선명하게 받쳐 주고, 모퉁이에서 나타나는 동선이라 한 벌씩 새로 등장하는 느낌이 남
concepts.camera_en: Fixed camera at eye level (about 1.5 m high), about 6 m from the wall she stops in front of, facing the wall squarely, vertical 9:16, no zoom, no shake, no movement.
concepts.pace_en: Light brisk walk, medium strides, about two steps per second, arms swinging gently, shoulders level, no bouncing or waddling.
concepts.light_en: Clear mid-morning sunlight coming from the upper left at an angle, warm glow on the ochre walls, soft pale blue sky, gentle shadows.
concepts.direction_en: She comes around the building corner at the left of the frame, walks diagonally toward the center, stops at the middle of the frame, then walks away to the right and exits the frame.

shots.pose: 멈춰서 오른손으로 자켓 금단추 근처 옷깃을 매만지고 카메라 보기
shots.motion_en: 0-2.5s: she rounds the building corner on the left and walks diagonally toward the center of the frame with medium strides, about two steps per second, arms swinging loosely, growing from about 45% to about 55% of the frame height. 2.5-3.3s: she stops at the middle of the frame at about 60% of the frame height, feet together, facing the camera. 3.3-4.5s: her right hand touches the jacket edge near the gold buttons and smooths it once, then she looks at the camera with a small smile. 4.5-5.5s: she walks out of frame to the right with a natural stride. One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts. There is no wind: hair and clothes move only with her steps and hands.

concepts.title: 해 질 녘 옥상, 제자리 옷매무새 고르기
concepts.background: 연한 라벤더 그레이 하늘이 보이는 낮은 콘크리트 난간의 텅 빈 옥상 한 곳, 난간 앞 가운데 같은 자리
concepts.background_en: An empty flat rooftop terrace at early dusk, smooth mid-grey concrete floor, a plain low concrete parapet behind with a soft hazy city skyline far away, pale lavender-grey and peach sky, no people, no signs, no text, no furniture.
concepts.framing: 세로 9:16, 눈높이, 난간 정면에서 조금 떨어져 촬영, 전신이 화면 높이의 약 65%, 카메라 고정
concepts.light: 해 진 직후 은은한 노을빛, 부드러운 복숭아색과 라벤더 그레이 색감
concepts.motion: 제자리에서 옷매무새 만지기 (서서 매무새 고르고 어깨 너머로 돌아본 뒤 오른쪽으로 퇴장)
concepts.why: 걷지 않고 제자리에서 옷깃·가방·치맛단을 만지는 동작이라 옷의 디테일이 가까이 보이고, 라벤더 그레이 하늘이 블랙과 아이보리 모두 또렷하게 받쳐 줌
concepts.pace: 서서 천천히 몸을 살짝 틀며 손만 가볍게 움직이기, 발은 거의 제자리
concepts.camera_en: Fixed camera at eye level (about 1.5 m high), about 6 m from her, facing the parapet squarely, vertical 9:16, no zoom, no shake, no movement.
concepts.pace_en: Unhurried: she stays on the same spot, feet nearly still, only a small weight shift and a slow quarter turn of the torso, hands move lightly and deliberately, no walking until the final exit step.
concepts.light_en: Soft afterglow just after sunset, peach and lavender grey tones, even gentle light on her, no hard shadows.
concepts.direction_en: She stands at the center of the frame facing the camera the whole time, turns her shoulders to glance back once, then steps out of frame to the right at the end.

shots.action: 가운데 서서 매무새 고르다 어깨 너머로 돌아보고 오른쪽으로 퇴장
shots.pose: 서서 오른손으로 스커트 단을 톡톡 정리하고 카메라 보며 웃기
shots.motion_en: 0-1s: she stands still at the center facing the camera, then takes a small breath. 1-3s: with her right hand she smooths the front of the mini skirt hem twice, the left hand holds the shoulder bag strap. 3-4s: she turns her shoulders slightly to the left and looks back over her left shoulder, then turns back to face the camera at about 60% of the frame height with a small smile. 4-5.5s: she walks out of frame to the right with a natural stride. One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts. There is no wind: hair and clothes move only with her steps and hands.
shots.start: 화면 가운데, 전신이 화면 세로의 약 60%, 서 있는 상태
shots.start_en: Full body standing at the horizontal center of the frame, about 60% of the frame height, facing the camera, weight on the left foot, both arms relaxed at her sides, still; not posing yet, no clothing adjustments.

shots.action: 가운데 서서 매무새 고르다 어깨 너머로 돌아보고 오른쪽으로 퇴장
shots.pose: 서서 양손 손끝으로 퍼 카라를 쓸어 정리하기 (코트는 여민 채)
shots.motion_en: 0-1s: she stands still at the center facing the camera, then takes a small breath. 1-3s: both hands brush the fur collar lightly with the fingertips from the sides toward the front, the coat stays closed as in the reference. 3-4s: she turns her shoulders slightly to the left and looks back over her left shoulder, then turns back to face the camera at about 60% of the frame height. 4-5s: she walks out of frame to the right with a natural stride. One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts. There is no wind: hair and clothes move only with her steps and hands.
shots.start: 화면 가운데, 전신이 화면 세로의 약 60%, 서 있는 상태
shots.start_en: Full body standing at the horizontal center of the frame, about 60% of the frame height, facing the camera, weight on the left foot, both arms relaxed at her sides, still; not posing yet, no clothing adjustments.
